changes.before: TikTok Ads is paid advertising that lets a business promote a message to eligible audiences through TikTok's advertising tools. For a service business, the useful question is whether that message can reach suitable people, explain something that matters and lead to a conversation the team can handle.
changes.after:
TikTok Ads is paid advertising that lets a business promote a message to eligible audiences through TikTok's advertising tools.

Say you run a landscaping business in Perth. You could explain what a customer needs before asking for a quote, which projects you handle or what happens after an enquiry. Would those explanations reach suitable people and lead to conversations your team can handle?

We will use that fictional business throughout this guide. No campaign or results are represented.
changes.reason: Adelantar el caso ya recibido y hablar al propietario; no inventar campaña, público probado o resultados.

changes.before: This guide explains the main decisions for Australian service businesses. It focuses on feed-based creative and enquiry generation, while recognising that TikTok also offers other placements and formats under specific availability rules.
changes.after: For an Australian service business, that means checking the creative work, contact route and costs before committing to a test. Feed-based creative is the focus here. Other placements and formats have their own availability rules.
changes.reason: Sustituir anuncio genérico de la guía por decisiones concretas, conservando el alcance.
